seeding.notice: Sharing helps other players download games and keeps torrents available. pipensx shares verified pieces while downloading and installing. After installation, it shares what remains in RAM until you exit or start another transfer. Sharing uses your connection and may affect download speed. You can turn it off in Settings → Downloads.

first_run.title: How to fetch releases
first_run.intro: pipensx can take files straight from the swarm, or through a server that sits in between.
first_run.torrserver_how: TorrServer already runs on your router, home server or VPS. The console downloads from it over your own network.
first_run.torrserver_peer: The swarm sees only your TorrServer — your IP stays hidden.
first_run.torrserver_setup: Setup required: enter the server address and port.
first_run.torbox_how: A paid cloud service: TorBox downloads the torrents for you, and the console pulls the files from its cloud.
first_run.torbox_peer: The swarm sees only TorBox — your IP stays hidden.
first_run.torbox_setup: Setup required: enter the key on the console, or send it from your phone by scanning a QR code.
first_run.realdebrid_how: A paid cloud service: Real-Debrid downloads the torrents for you, and the console pulls the files from its cloud.
first_run.realdebrid_peer: The swarm sees only Real-Debrid — your IP stays hidden.
first_run.realdebrid_setup: Setup required: enter the API token on the console, or send it from your phone by scanning a QR code.
first_run.alldebrid_how: A paid cloud service: AllDebrid downloads the torrents for you, and the console pulls the files from its cloud.
first_run.alldebrid_peer: The swarm sees only AllDebrid — your IP stays hidden.
first_run.alldebrid_setup: Setup required: enter the API key on the console, or send it from your phone by scanning a QR code.
first_run.direct_how: The console joins the swarm directly and downloads the files itself.
first_run.direct_peer: Every peer in the swarm sees your IP address. In Russia, Ukraine and the CIS this is largely ignored; in Germany and Austria your provider may forward a copyright notice, sometimes with a bill attached.
first_run.direct_hint_no: Not a good fit for your region
first_run.note: You can change this later in Settings.
